summary: Positions 0-149: Haiku had 33 photo, 10 unsure, 107 skip. Of the 33 photo entries: 23 keep_ok as written, 5 kept but need a fix (name fixes on arenes-de-maracay, rundling, st-michael-s-church; year null on thiel-gallery; a different main photo for proxima), 5 keep_wrong. keep_ok excludes the ids in keep_fix and main_photo_wrong, which are still kept after the fix. Rescued 3: stadtbad-mitte, lake-suwa-museum (year null), philologica. Final kept = 31; ordinary types among them = 5 (16 percent). Of the 117 unsure/skip entries, 29 have an empty lead (skip by rule, including bagno-pubblico-bellinzona, already on the wall), 6 have no usable photo (sun-terrace has none at all, hearst-gymnasium, branigan, slovenia assembly, experimental-theater, north-casper-clubhouse), the rest are ordinary or give no design reason. Borderline left out: ullensaker-church (Arneberg, only a local nickname), gewerbehaus (Schumacher, year unclear), kyoto-municipal-museum-of-art (lead says 1928, no design reason). Notes: villa-tonder has only historic photos (confirm it still stands). No dup_flag entries and no duplicates on the wall found by id, name, QID or 250 m.
